scope: Independent review of new runtime and its tests; reviewer authored package and qualification, not this runtime.
method: Compared run_session source AST span with existing run_session; all differences classified.
Verified original file hash and function hash including final newline.
Reviewed actual scratch integration tests covering each arm, external sandbox and fake host boundary.
conclusions: Task component remains exactly Work on <actual issue ID>. Startup arm alone adds one common labeled user-message briefing before that task.
Both installed PRIME.md files and original lifecycle administrative prime output are checked against the declared arm; startup retains thin prime.
Task, launch and briefing evidence use exclusive creation and independent hashes. Administrative setup prime evidence is labeled rather than treated as agent exposure.
Previously completed slots return their retained result; a claimed incomplete slot refuses before another model launch.
Actual workspace, issue history, memory and native-state carry-forward, host adapters, sandbox, receipt ancestry and independent artifact grader remain unchanged.
No tool-discovery or memory-write hook, memory-body injection, answer repair or hidden-score feedback was added.
limits: Submitted startup bytes establish launch transport; attention and actual model-visible exposure require trace review.
PRIME.md mutation refusal is a deliberate new frozen-condition check. Other agent-created state remains retained.
Qualification and model behavior remain separate validation steps; this code review makes no scored-adoption claim.
